headline: New: the Handover check – know a project is ready before you send it to another editor.
notes: New: Handover in the Project view checks that everything will travel with the project's folder
It lists files outside the folder by where they are – Desktop, Downloads, cloud-sync, another drive – with what they weigh
It also flags offline files and proxies kept outside the folder
Press Change to check against a different folder; Trace+ remembers it for that project
Copy report gives you the whole list to send with the project
